run_counters.cost_usd: money spent by the run, as reported by the host
run_counters.tokens_total: input plus output tokens across every session in the run
run_counters.wall_time_seconds: elapsed time from first request to final artifact
run_counters.invalid_decisions: decisions rejected by the same external validity checks applied to all three variants
run_counters.rework_cycles: times a produced artifact was withdrawn and redone within the run

judged_counters.factual_errors: statements contradicted by the case material
judged_counters.fatal_defects: defects that would make the artifact unusable or unsafe to act on
judged_counters.constraint_violations: breaches of a limit the case stated explicitly

judged_fractions.evidence_coverage: claims carrying a usable evidence reference, over claims requiring one

composite_score: NOT_DEFINED: the metrics trade against each other and are reported separately. Ranking requires a stated purpose this protocol does not hold.
